differences.title: 1. ARCHITECTURE
differences.leftDesc: Milvus uses a distributed architecture with distinct components (Proxy, QueryNode, DataNode) for scalability and fault tolerance, managing data and query workloads separately.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate offers both monolithic (all-in-one) and distributed deployments, simplifying setup while allowing scalable horizontal partitioning for production workloads.

differences.title: 2. DATA MODELING
differences.leftDesc: Milvus enforces a strict schema for collections, defining data types and vector parameters upfront, ensuring data consistency and optimized indexing.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate uses a schema that can be defined or inferred, supporting rich data types and relationships, making it flexible for evolving data needs.

differences.title: 3. INDEXING
differences.leftDesc: Milvus supports various ANN index types like IVF_FLAT, HNSW, and ANNOY, allowing users to choose based on performance and accuracy trade-offs.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate features its own efficient ANN index implementation and supports multi-tenancy, automatically managing indexes for different data classes.

differences.title: 4. SCALABILITY
differences.leftDesc: Milvus scales horizontally by adding more nodes for each component, enabling massive datasets and high query throughput with stateless proxies.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate scales horizontally through sharding and replication, with features that can automate scaling based on load and data size.

differences.title: 5. QUERYING
differences.leftDesc: Milvus allows hybrid search by combining vector similarity search with scalar filtering on metadata attributes within collections.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate excels at hybrid search, combining vector search with keyword search (BM25) and filtering, offering powerful semantic and lexical capabilities.

differences.title: 6. DEPLOYMENT
differences.leftDesc: Milvus is primarily designed for Kubernetes deployments, leveraging its orchestration capabilities for managing distributed services and ensuring high availability.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud services, catering to diverse infrastructure needs.

differences.title: 7. DATA MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Milvus supports data partitioning by scalar fields for better query performance and data management within large collections.
differences.rightDesc: Weaviate offers built-in multi-tenancy, allowing different applications or teams to use the same instance with isolated data and schemas.
